about:
PFI Fashions Inc operates from Genoa City, Wisconsin. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in public sources. It presents itself as a wholesale and contract apparel decoration business.

The company provides a range of decoration services including screen printing, embroidery, direct-to-film (DTF) heat transfers, private labeling, and patch application. It also supplies promotional products and sideline vests, positioning itself as a one-stop shop for branded apparel. No details on facility size, headcount, or annual volume are provided.

PFI Fashions serves the promotional marketing sector, offering branded merchandise to businesses and organizations seeking customized apparel. Its product lineup includes items such as sideline vests, sport bibs, sublimated vests, and elastic side smocks, suggesting a focus on team and corporate wear.

The company states that it “obsesses over the details and strives to deliver the best products at the best prices, every time,” and emphasizes a continuously expanding range of national brands. No specific founding mission or unique origin story is documented.
